description: This file defines the ReaderState class which maintains the state while reading configuration definitions. It includes data structures for managing configuration structures and custom line/size information, as well as a method to ensure all structures are properly closed.

classes.name: ReaderState
classes.description: A class that maintains the reading state when parsing configuration definitions, managing structures and custom properties, and ensuring proper structure closure.

methods.name: ensureEmptyAfterProcessing
methods.description: Verifies that the stack of configuration structures is empty, throwing an exception if there are unclosed structures.
